hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei, commander of the Sichuan Province Public Security Armed Forces Department's 2nd Company, had remained in the rear, and he had felt uneasy about this operation from the very beginning.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei, commander of the Sichuan Province Public Security Armed Forces Department’s 2nd Company, had remained in the rear, and the operation had made him uneasy from the very beginning.

hunks.baseline: *Go ahead with the army and occupy the city? That's different from the orders Colonel Xiao gave me.*
hunks.sol: *Go ahead with the army and occupy the city? That’s different from Colonel Shao’s orders.*

hunks.baseline: The doubt in Zhang Wei's mind had only grown when they deliberately bypassed their allies engaged in combat up ahead and advanced farther in.
hunks.sol: His doubts had only deepened when they deliberately bypassed their allies fighting up ahead and continued their advance.

hunks.baseline: A high-ranking, middle-aged officer frowned at Zhang Wei's question.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged senior officer frowned at Zhang Wei’s question.

hunks.baseline: “Why are you curious about that?”
hunks.sol: “Why do you want to know?”

hunks.baseline: “No matter how I think about it, something feels wrong. Our regimental commander clearly told us to conserve our strength in the rear and guard headquarters…”
hunks.sol: “No matter how I look at it, something feels wrong. Our regimental commander clearly ordered us to conserve our strength in the rear and guard headquarters….”

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei's expression hardened at the senior officer's mocking tone toward Xiao Shen.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei’s expression hardened at the officer’s mocking tone toward Shao Shen.

hunks.baseline: “Regimental Commander Xiao Shen holds the same rank as you, Colonel Wang. And he's about to be promoted to major general.”
hunks.sol: “Regimental Commander Shao Shen holds the same rank as you, Colonel Wang. And he’ll soon be promoted to major general.”

hunks.baseline: “That child knows nothing about the world. He was lucky, that's all. As if awakening as an A-rank Hunter wasn't enough, he even made the promotion list this time thanks to that Korean bastard's exploits. Looking at how quickly he's risen through the ranks, I wonder if he has some decent guanxi[^1] in political circles.”
hunks.sol: “That child knows nothing about the world. He was simply lucky. As if awakening as an A-rank Hunter wasn’t enough, he even made the promotion list thanks to that Korean bastard’s exploits. Considering how quickly he’s risen through the ranks, I wonder if he has some useful guanxi[^1] in political circles.”

hunks.baseline: “He may be young, but he's exceptionally capable. He's highly respected, and he's close enough to us to treat us like brothers.”
hunks.sol: “He may be young, but he’s exceptionally capable. He’s also highly respected—he’s close enough to us to treat us like brothers.”

hunks.baseline: The senior officer ran his hand along the command baton he was holding.
hunks.sol: The senior officer stroked the command baton in his hand.

hunks.baseline: “I know perfectly well that Hunters don't recognize ranks. But this is wartime. This order came from General Liao, the commander.”
hunks.sol: “I know perfectly well that Hunters don’t care about rank. But this is wartime. This order came from General Liao, the commander.”

hunks.baseline: “That's right. So if you don't want to follow the order, go back now. But I hope you understand that what you're doing right now constitutes disobedience.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. So if you don’t want to obey, you may turn back now. Just remember that doing so would constitute disobedience.”

hunks.baseline: “We're only trying to shorten our advance time. Given the circumstances, it's unlikely, but if there are any monster stragglers left, we'll wipe them out and rescue any civilians in danger. That's all. Do you understand?”
hunks.sol: “We’re merely trying to speed up our advance. Given the circumstances, it’s unlikely there are any monsters left behind, but if there are, we’ll wipe them out and rescue any civilians in danger. That’s all. Understood?”

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei remained silent for a long while before nodding and stepping away.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei remained silent for a long moment before nodding and withdrawing.

hunks.baseline: The Public Security Armed Forces Department was generally treated as a separate organization that did not belong to the military. But this was wartime. Defying General Liao, the commander of the western front, was by no means a wise choice.
hunks.sol: The Public Security Armed Forces Department was generally treated as a separate organization outside the military, but this was wartime. Defying General Liao, commander of the western front, would not be a wise choice.

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei answered the subordinate who asked in a lowered voice.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei answered his subordinate’s hushed question.

hunks.baseline: “He said to shut up and follow because it's an easy operation. Refusing would be disobedience.”
hunks.sol: “He said it’s an easy operation, so we should shut up and follow him. If we refuse, it’s disobedience.”

hunks.baseline: “If you're asking whether I believe the first part, of course not. But the second part is probably true. What do you think?”
hunks.sol: “If you mean the first part, of course not. But the second part is probably true. What do you think?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I don't believe him. That bastard Colonel Wang has made it this far on nothing but his guanxi with the Crown Prince Party, despite having no ability of his own. Everyone says he's General Liao's obedient dog.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I don’t believe him. That bastard Colonel Wang has no ability of his own. He only made it this far because of his guanxi with the Crown Prince Party. Everyone says he’s General Liao’s obedient dog.”

hunks.baseline: “It is an order from that very General Liao. Even if it smells rotten, we have no choice but to endure it for now.”
hunks.sol: “And this order came from that very General Liao. Even if something stinks, we have no choice but to endure it for now.”

hunks.baseline: “……Damn it.”
hunks.sol: “…Damn it.”

hunks.baseline: “But Colonel Wang might be telling the truth. Most of the monsters in the surrounding area are probably engaged in combat with our allies. With our current strength, we should be more than capable of handling a few monster stragglers.”
hunks.sol: “But Colonel Wang might be telling the truth. Most of the monsters in the surrounding area should be fighting our allies. With our current forces, we can handle a few stragglers.”

hunks.baseline: In addition to the hundred Hunters, including himself, there were more than twenty tanks and five hundred infantrymen. Three attack helicopters were advancing overhead, keeping watch on the surroundings.
hunks.sol: In addition to the hundred Hunters, including himself, they had more than twenty tanks and five hundred infantrymen. Three attack helicopters flew overhead, scouting their surroundings as they advanced.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps Zhang Wei's wish had reached the heavens, because what he feared did not happen.
hunks.sol: Perhaps Zhang Wei’s wish reached the heavens, because what he feared did not happen.

hunks.baseline: The small city near Suining that they entered with every sense alert had been utterly devastated by monsters, but the ruined downtown was completely silent.
hunks.sol: They entered a small city near Suining with every sense alert. Monsters had devastated the place, but the ruined downtown was utterly silent.

hunks.baseline: Monsters such as goblins and Orcs occasionally sprang out, but they posed no threat whatsoever.
hunks.sol: The occasional goblin or Orc sprang out at them, but none posed any real threat.

hunks.baseline: After killing a dozen or so monsters at the very front, Zhang Wei felt a little less tense.
hunks.sol: After killing a dozen or so monsters at the head of the column, Zhang Wei relaxed a little.

hunks.baseline: “The monsters are appearing separately, even by species. They must have broken away from their groups.”
hunks.sol: “Even monsters of different species are appearing separately. They must have strayed from their groups.”

hunks.baseline: The officer's arrogant tone was unpleasant, but this was still preferable.
hunks.sol: The officer’s arrogant tone grated on him, but this was still preferable to the alternative.

hunks.baseline: Thinking that, Zhang Wei silently nodded. Then he stopped short at the senior officer's next words.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei silently nodded, only to stop short at the senior officer’s next words.

hunks.baseline: “That's right. In a situation like this, we need to find the survivors as quickly as possible.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. Under these circumstances, we should find the survivors as quickly as possible.”

hunks.baseline: “But, Colonel Wang. We haven't even been inside for an hour yet. We should advance a little farther toward the center first…”
hunks.sol: “But, Colonel Wang, we haven’t even been inside the city for an hour. We should advance a little farther toward the center before—”

hunks.baseline: “Don't get insolent.”
hunks.sol: “Watch your insolence.”

hunks.baseline: “You Hunters may be better at fighting, but I'm several steps ahead of you when it comes to tactics. I have command authority right now, so shut your mouth and follow orders.”
hunks.sol: “You Hunters may be better at fighting, but I’m several steps ahead of you when it comes to tactics. I currently hold command authority, so shut your mouth and follow my orders.”

hunks.baseline: “Didn't you hear me? Should I give the order to your men myself?”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t you hear me? Shall I give the order to your men myself?”

hunks.baseline: “……I'll do it.”
hunks.sol: “…I’ll do it.”

hunks.baseline: “You have a detailed map, I assume. Then we'll meet at the central square in two hours.”
hunks.sol: “You have a detailed map, I assume. We’ll meet in the central square in two hours.”

hunks.baseline: The officer gave Zhang Wei an unpleasant smile and was just about to climb into an armored vehicle when—
hunks.sol: The officer gave Zhang Wei an obnoxious smile and was about to climb into an armored vehicle when—

hunks.baseline: Whoooooosh! Boom!
hunks.sol: Whoooosh! Boom!

hunks.baseline: When he wiped his face with his palm, a large amount of sticky blood came away on it.
hunks.sol: He wiped his face with one hand, and his palm came away covered in sticky blood.

hunks.baseline: It was unmistakably human blood, an endless shade of red, and the body of the officer—whose upper torso had already vanished without a trace—was rolling out of the armored vehicle.
hunks.sol: It was unmistakably human, a vivid crimson. The officer’s body, its upper half gone without a trace, toppled from the armored vehicle.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone, prepare for battle—!”
hunks.sol: “Everyone, prepare for battle!”

hunks.baseline: “Monster! Monsters have appeared!”
hunks.sol: “Monsters! Monsters have appeared!”

hunks.baseline: “The regimental commander has been killed!”
hunks.sol: “Th-the regimental commander has been killed!”

hunks.baseline: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department reacted first to the shouts. The soldiers understood what had happened a beat later.
hunks.sol: The Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department were the first to react to those shouts. The soldiers took a moment longer to grasp what had happened.

hunks.baseline: And waiting for them, already thrown into utter chaos by the sudden death of their commander, was an even more horrific death.
hunks.sol: Already plunged into utter chaos by the sudden death of their commander, they were met by an even more horrific fate.

hunks.baseline: Whoooooosh!
hunks.sol: Whoooosh!

hunks.baseline: There was only a single sound of something piercing the air.
hunks.sol: A single sound tore through the air.

hunks.baseline: A beam of light shot forward at an invisible speed and swept through the soldiers advancing in orderly ranks and files.
hunks.sol: A streak of light, moving too quickly to see, swept through the soldiers marching in orderly ranks.

hunks.baseline: The beam burst dozens of people like balloons as it passed through them. Its final target was the armored vehicle moving under the protection of the infantry.
hunks.sol: It burst dozens of people like balloons before finally piercing the armored vehicle moving under infantry escort.

hunks.baseline: The beam pierced through the hard outer shell and bored deep into the vehicle's interior.
hunks.sol: The streak of light punched through the vehicle’s hardened shell and bored deep inside.

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei witnessed the sight and shouted like a thunderclap.
hunks.sol: The moment Zhang Wei saw it, he roared like thunder.

hunks.baseline: But before his voice could reach them, the deafening roar that erupted in the next moment swallowed everything.
hunks.sol: But before his warning could reach them, a deafening explosion swallowed everything.

hunks.baseline: Along with a red flash and black smoke, fragments of the armored vehicle shot in every direction, becoming hundreds—thousands—of blades that ripped through everything around them.
hunks.sol: The armored vehicle erupted in a flash of red and a cloud of black smoke. Hundreds—thousands—of fragments became blades that tore through everything around them.

hunks.baseline: Soldiers and lower-ranking Hunters who had been unable to react in time alike fell like bundles of straw.
hunks.sol: Soldiers and lower-ranking Hunters who had failed to react in time collapsed like bundles of straw.

hunks.baseline: The bodies of those who were already dead did not move at all.
hunks.sol: Their lifeless bodies did not so much as twitch.

hunks.baseline: “W-what the hell is this…?”
hunks.sol: “W-what the hell…?”

hunks.baseline: But the bodies of soldiers experiencing actual combat for the first time had gone rigid, and the unseen enemy never failed to take advantage of the enemy's confusion.
hunks.sol: But the soldiers, experiencing combat for the first time in their lives, had gone rigid. The unseen enemy did not let their confusion go to waste.

hunks.baseline: Whooooooosh!
hunks.sol: Whoooooosh!

hunks.baseline: But unlike before, there was more than one beam of light.
hunks.sol: This time, however, there was more than one streak of light.

hunks.baseline: Flames shot upward, and screams flooded the air.
hunks.sol: Flames surged upward, and screams flooded the air.

hunks.baseline: The more than twenty armored vehicles and tanks were rendered useless in no more than an instant.
hunks.sol: The destruction of more than twenty armored vehicles and tanks took no more than an instant.

hunks.baseline: The three attack helicopters circling overhead were also reduced to countless fragments and came crashing down to the ground.
hunks.sol: The three attack helicopters circling overhead were also reduced to countless fragments and crashed to the ground.

hunks.baseline: Boom! Rattle-rattle-rattle.
hunks.sol: Boom! Clatter-clatter-clatter.

hunks.baseline: In the horrific scene that could only be called a sea of corpses and blood, Zhang Wei felt a chill run down his spine.
hunks.sol: Amid a horrific scene that could only be called a sea of corpses and blood, Zhang Wei felt a chill run down his spine.

hunks.baseline: *At least A-rank monsters. And there isn't just one or two of them.*
hunks.sol: *At least A-rank monsters. And there aren’t just one or two.*

hunks.baseline: Between dark alleys and collapsed buildings. On the rooftop of a building that was still burning.
hunks.sol: Between dark alleys and collapsed buildings. Atop the roof of a building still engulfed in flames.

hunks.baseline: Ten figures that had appeared like black mist stared down at the hundreds of surviving humans with burning violet eyes.
hunks.sol: Ten figures appeared like black mist and stared down at the surviving humans with burning violet eyes.

hunks.baseline: When Zhang Wei spotted the figures mounted on warhorses with nothing but bones left on them, a groan-like word escaped between his lips.
hunks.sol: When Zhang Wei saw them mounted on warhorses that had been stripped to the bone, a word escaped his lips like a groan.

hunks.baseline: “……Death Knights.”
hunks.sol: “…Death Knights.”

hunks.baseline: Knights of death who had once been noble, but had been corrupted by black magic.
hunks.sol: Knights who had once been noble, only to be corrupted by black magic.

hunks.baseline: The very Death Knights who had vanished along with the Lich after the Great Cataclysm had appeared. There were no fewer than ten of them.
hunks.sol: The very Death Knights who had vanished alongside the Lich after the Great Cataclysm had appeared.
Ten of them.

hunks.baseline: The first word that came to Zhang Wei's mind was *death*.
hunks.sol: The first word that came to Zhang Wei’s mind was *death*.

hunks.baseline: Death Knights were beings that had surpassed A-rank monsters.
hunks.sol: Death Knights were beings that surpassed A-rank monsters.

hunks.baseline: A hundred Hunters and a military force still remained, but Zhang Wei already knew.
hunks.sol: A hundred Hunters and part of the military force still remained, but Zhang Wei already knew.

hunks.baseline: They could not escape the net the monsters had spread.
hunks.sol: There was no escaping the net they had cast.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the soldiers, who were too frightened to even hold their guns properly, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department raised their weapons with determined eyes.
hunks.sol: Unlike the soldiers, who were too frightened even to hold their guns properly, the Hunters of the Public Security Armed Forces Department raised their weapons with determination in their eyes.

hunks.baseline: “You don't have to go this far.”
hunks.sol: “You don’t have to do this.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: One of the platoon commanders answered Zhang Wei's low murmur bluntly.
hunks.sol: One of the platoon commanders answered Zhang Wei’s quiet words bluntly.

hunks.baseline: “And you're allowed to?”
hunks.sol: “And you do?”

hunks.baseline: “I'm sorry. I shouldn't have brought you here.”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have brought you here.”

hunks.baseline: “No one brought us. We followed you. We've survived more than ten times thanks to you, so it was about time we did this at least once.”
hunks.sol: “You didn’t bring us. We followed you. We’ve survived more than ten times thanks to you, so I’d say we were due for something like this.”

hunks.baseline: He spoke casually, but he could not hide the trembling in his voice.
hunks.sol: He spoke as though it were nothing, but he couldn’t hide the tremor in his voice.

hunks.baseline: Zhang Wei licked his parched lips as he stared at the ten Death Knights standing completely motionless.
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei licked his parched lips as he stared at the ten motionless Death Knights.

hunks.baseline: “Fight with everything you have, and make sure at least one of you survives. That's all I have to say.”
hunks.sol: “Fight with everything you have, and make sure at least one of you survives. That’s all I have to say.”

hunks.baseline: A booming cheer erupted instead of an answer.
hunks.sol: A thunderous cheer answered him.

hunks.baseline: The Hunters' eyes shone like morning stars, having driven away their fear.
hunks.sol: The Hunters cast off their fear, their eyes shining like morning stars.

hunks.baseline: If they had wanted a safe and prosperous life, they had other paths available to them.
hunks.sol: If they had wanted safe, prosperous lives, they could have chosen another path.

hunks.baseline: But they had chosen the Public Security Armed Forces Department instead of becoming bodyguards for wealthy entrepreneurs or working as mercenaries because of their honor and sense of responsibility as Hunters.
hunks.sol: But they had joined the Public Security Armed Forces Department instead of becoming bodyguards for wealthy businessmen or working as mercenaries because of their honor and sense of responsibility as Hunters.

hunks.baseline: “Go! Sons and daughters of the people, descendants of Zhonghua!”
hunks.sol: “Let’s go! Sons and daughters of the people, descendants of Zhonghua!”

hunks.baseline: Just as Zhang Wei finished shouting with all his strength and was about to charge toward the nearest Death Knight—
hunks.sol: Zhang Wei had just finished shouting with all his strength and was about to charge the nearest Death Knight when—

hunks.baseline: A massive energy could be felt alongside the violent tremors. The surviving humans turned their heads, terror making every hair on their bodies stand on end.
hunks.sol: The ground shook violently, and a vast, overwhelming energy washed over them. Every surviving human turned toward it, terror making their hair stand on end.

hunks.baseline: Where all those eyes turned, a black knight was slowly crossing the ruined downtown.
hunks.sol: There, where all their gazes converged, a black knight slowly crossed the ruined city center.

hunks.baseline: Red eyes flashed beneath the deeply lowered helmet. The breath of death poured through its bloodless lips.
hunks.sol: Red eyes flashed beneath a helmet pulled low over its face. The breath of death spilled from its bloodless lips.

hunks.baseline: “—Sar, Garrosh.”
hunks.sol: “Sar, Garosh.”

hunks.baseline: It was a language from the demon realm that no one could understand.
hunks.sol: Words in a language of the Demon Realm that no one could understand.

hunks.baseline: Yet in the next instant, Zhang Wei realized what those words meant.
hunks.sol: Yet in the next instant, Zhang Wei realized what they meant.

hunks.baseline: Reflected in Zhang Wei's widened eyes were the ten Death Knights charging in from every direction.
hunks.sol: The ten Death Knights charged from every direction, reflected in Zhang Wei’s widened eyes.

hunks.baseline: The slaughter had begun.
hunks.sol: The slaughter began.

hunks.baseline: A horse hoof made of nothing but bone stepped into a pool of blood.
hunks.sol: A hoof stripped to bare bone stepped into a pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: The Death Knights who approached the black knight, who was staring down at the corpse of the middle-aged Hunter Zhang Wei—the last to resist—knelt on one knee.
hunks.sol: The black knight gazed down at the corpse of Zhang Wei, the middle-aged Hunter who had resisted to the very end. The approaching Death Knights knelt before him on one knee.

hunks.baseline: “—Lord. Your next command.”
hunks.sol: “Lord. Your next command.”

hunks.baseline: The black knight was silent for a moment before suddenly extending a hand.
hunks.sol: The black knight remained silent for a moment, then abruptly extended a hand.

hunks.baseline: A black beam lashed out like a whip and sliced through concrete and rebar.
hunks.sol: A black streak of light lashed out like a whip, slicing through concrete and rebar.

hunks.baseline: A building collapsed at an angle. In the exposed space inside, several humans crouched together, desperately covering their mouths.
hunks.sol: The building collapsed at an angle. Within the exposed interior, several humans huddled together with their hands clamped over their mouths.

hunks.baseline: “Jinjin. Honey. It's okay, it's okay…”
hunks.sol: “Jinjin. Honey. It’s okay. It’s okay….”

hunks.baseline: “Sniff… sob…”
hunks.sol: “Sniff… sob….”

hunks.baseline: A being so small and light that it was impossible to distinguish its sex.
hunks.sol: A creature so small and light that he could not yet tell whether it was male or female.

hunks.baseline: *Was that what they called a child?*
hunks.sol: Was that what they called a child?

hunks.baseline: The black knight pushed the question aside and extended his hand. Every human in sight had to be annihilated. That was the command he had received.
hunks.sol: Pushing the sudden question aside, the black knight reached out. Every human he saw had to be annihilated. That was the command he had received.

hunks.baseline: They were undoubtedly weak beings who would turn into a handful of blood and vanish from a mere flick of his finger, yet it was as though an invisible barrier surrounded and protected them.
hunks.sol: They were undoubtedly frail beings who would dissolve into a handful of blood at the mere flick of his finger, yet it was as though an invisible barrier surrounded them.

hunks.baseline: At the black knight's eerie voice, the child squirming in its parents' arms suddenly began to wail.
hunks.sol: At the black knight’s eerie voice, the child squirming in its parents’ arms burst into tears.

hunks.baseline: “This is…”
hunks.sol: “This…”

hunks.baseline: The black knight abruptly raised his head and looked beyond the ruins, then turned his mount around.
hunks.sol: The black knight abruptly raised his head and stared into the distance, then turned his mount around.

hunks.baseline: The Death Knights expressed their confusion at their leader's sudden action.
hunks.sol: The Death Knights voiced their confusion at their leader’s sudden action.

hunks.baseline: “—Lord?”
hunks.sol: “Lord?”

hunks.baseline: “We're going back. Now. At once.”
hunks.sol: “We’re going back. Now. At once.”

hunks.baseline: “Then shall we deal with the humans—”
hunks.sol: “Then we’ll deal with the humans—”

hunks.baseline: “We're going back. Now. At once.”
hunks.sol: “We’re going back. Now. At once.”

hunks.baseline: The ten Death Knights bowed on one knee in deference before riding after their leader.
hunks.sol: The ten Death Knights knelt in acknowledgment, then mounted their steeds and followed their leader.

hunks.baseline: Just before their figures vanished like mist, the black knight's red gaze fell upon the three humans who had survived as if by a miracle, then moved away.
hunks.sol: Just before they vanished like mist, the black knight’s red gaze fell upon the three humans who had miraculously survived, then moved away.

hunks.baseline: Whooooooosh.
hunks.sol: Whoooooosh.

hunks.baseline: Wind carrying the smell of blood swept through the ruin filled with corpses.
hunks.sol: The blood-scented wind swept through the corpse-filled ruins.
